name: SLS Playa Mujeres
positioning: All-inclusive beachfront resort at Playa Mujeres, Cancun, with swim-out and rooftop jacuzzi rooms, a large spa, an adults-only pool club and dedicated kids and teen clubs
best_for: Families who want kids and teen clubs, a splash zone and swim-out rooms
Couples and friends who want an all-inclusive stay with an adults-only pool club
Golfers who want a Greg Norman course minutes away

facts.text: The resort has 17 chef-led restaurants and bars.
The resort is all-inclusive: everything is included, from coffee, smoothies or the buffet in the morning to poolside lunch, afternoon gelato and a steakhouse dinner.
SLS Elite rooms and suites come with personal butler service and private check-in, pool and beach areas.
Coati Kids Club is a dedicated space for ages 4 to 12, with a weekly rotation of activities from arts and crafts to robot building.
The Teen Lounge, for ages 12 to 17, has billiards, video games and activities from Fortnite tournaments to water polo.
A kids splash zone with slides, sprinklers and tipping buckets sits alongside the family pool.
The resort has an indoor movie theatre.
SLS Sculpt offers two 24/7 gyms and a schedule of group classes.
Smoke & Mirrors is a bar influenced by South American speakeasies, serving spirits alongside fine cigars.
Childcare is available day and night, with support from Cancun Nancy Service.
Kosher dining is available through the resort's Liora program.
The Envy Three Bedroom Suite has three king bedrooms with ensuites and an expansive outdoor terrace with sea views.

highlights.text: Swim-out rooms are set along a winding river pool, so guests step out of the room and into the water.
Rooftop jacuzzi rooms are bi-level, with a private rooftop deck, a jacuzzi, a lounge and panoramic sea views.
Ciel Spa is a 20,000 sq ft destination spa with massages, facials, body treatments, a hydrotherapy circuit and a full-service salon.
Twiggy by La Cantine is an adults-oriented restaurant and pool club; its pool is open daily to guests over 18, with multiple jacuzzis and a central swim-up bar.
Playa Mujeres Golf, an 18-hole, par-72 course designed by Greg Norman, is minutes from the resort.

considerations.text: Some upgrades, such as SLS Elite, are offered for additional fees on top of the all-inclusive rate.
The resort sits in a double-gated community, with multiple security checkpoints on arrival.
WhataHotel notes a higher price point that reflects the luxury positioning.
